title: Commons and donation update.
summary: Hey everyone, I've been chugging along working on the commons still. Right now, I am building the perpetual engine for the calendar. Which is a massive undertaking within itself. I used three different ordos from that time period to build the calendar engine. Now I could have used various websites and API's to have everything ready, but what is the fun in that? There A LOT of different commons that need to be verified for translations, accuracy, and authenticity. The commons will look, feel, and read just like the normal hours will. Also, might be adding a donation tab soon....Not real happy about but it cost about $40 a month to keep open to operate. That's the site cost and the tools I use to create all of this for everyone. Truly, because I want this to help people get closer to the Lord. ---Project Liturgy
